findings.title: Exact page-size counts produce an extra page
findings.body: When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit`, this formula adds an extra page: 50 members at a limit of 50 reports 2 pages, and 100 reports 3. The admin next action can then fetch at `offset == user_count`, showing an empty page that the UI treats as valid. Calculate the ceiling of `user_count / limit` (while preserving the zero-member case).

findings.title: Public group member lists are silently truncated at 50
findings.body: This query now limits every group's members, but the public group-members route fetches the list only once and its template has no pagination controls. Groups with more than 50 members therefore display only the first 50; previously ordinary groups returned all members, and automatic groups could return up to 200. Add pagination to the public page or preserve its ability to load the full list.
